steps.what: Total daily transactions on the existing computer
Compare the counted drawer with the stored balance
Balance currency, coin, and checks by hand
Judge the drawer difference at the end of the shift
Sign the drawer balance
File the signed drawer balance
outputs: filed copy of signed drawer balance v1

tasks.design: The existing computer in {ERP} already totals daily transactions, and that time is not a saving. A new job compares the counted drawer with the stored balance. The teller balances currency, coin, and checks by hand and judges the difference. A later job files the signed balance in {DOCS}. It does not move the cash.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drawer totals were copied before the count.
tasks.enabler_now: Drawer identifier and stored balance are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The cash is still counted by hand.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides whether the drawer balances.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the drawer, not on totaling the computer.

reach.task: Accept only the drawer the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.
The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Drawer identifier, currency amount, coin amount, check amount, and shift date are stored on the ledger record. The ledger record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not treated as zero.
Native configuration of the ledger record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the teller balancing currency, coin, and checks by hand.

incremental.description: Refresh drawer identifier and stored balance when the ledger layout changes, and drop a balance the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many drawer amounts are blank. The high end assumes drawer identifier and stored balance are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Receive cash and check deposit slips.

steps.what: Compare deposit slips with the received amounts
Receive checks and cash for deposit
Verify amounts and the accuracy of deposit slips
Sign the deposit check
File the signed deposit check
outputs: filed copy of signed deposit check v1

tasks.design: A job in {BANK} compares deposit slips with the received amounts and posts nothing unless the amounts match. The teller receives the checks and cash and verifies the accuracy of the deposit slips. A later job files the signed check in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Slip totals were rekeyed before the count.
tasks.enabler_now: Slip identifier and slip amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The cash is still received at the window.
tasks.human_edge: The teller accepts or refuses the deposit.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the deposit, not on comparing the slip.

reach.task: Hand over only what the teller received

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a match is posted only on an exact amount, and any miss stops with a person.
The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Slip identifier, item amount, and slip total are stored on the deposit record. The deposit record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not treated as a match.
Native configuration of the deposit record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining check is still the teller verifying amounts and deposit slips.

incremental.description: Refresh slip identifier and slip amount when the deposit layout changes, and drop a deposit the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many slip amounts are blank. The high end assumes slip identifier and slip amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List vault cash balances against the stored figure
Monitor bank vaults and count the cash
Decide whether each cash balance is correct
Sign the vault count
File the signed vault count
outputs: filed copy of signed vault count v1

tasks.design: A job lists vault cash balances in {BANK} against the stored figure. The teller monitors the bank vaults and decides whether the cash balance is correct. A later job files the signed count in {DOCS}. It does not move the cash.
tasks.previous_blocker: Vault figures were copied before the visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Vault identifier and stored balance are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The vault is still counted in person.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the balance is correct.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week in the vault, not on listing the figure.

reach.task: Accept only the count the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Vault identifier, stored balance, and count date are stored on the vault record. The vault record produces them. A blank balance stays blank and is not treated as correct.
Native configuration of the vault record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the teller monitoring the vault.

incremental.description: Refresh vault identifier and stored balance when the vault layout changes, and drop a count the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many vault balances are blank. The high end assumes vault identifier and stored balance are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.short: Cash checks only after a signature.

steps.what: Compare written and numerical amounts and stored funds
Verify that signatures on the checks are correct
Pay out money only after those checks agree
Sign the payout amount
Release only the signed payout
outputs: filed copy of signed payout v1

tasks.design: A job in {BANK} compares the written amount, the numerical amount, and the stored funds. The teller verifies the signature and pays out the money. A later job releases only the signed payout. It does not use biometrics and it does not score creditworthiness. A blank signature is not treated as correct.
tasks.previous_blocker: Amounts were read aloud before the payout.
tasks.enabler_now: Account identifier and stored funds are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The signature and the cash stay at the window.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the signature and the cash, not on comparing the amounts.

reach.task: Take only the payout the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
The executive digest says a match is posted only on an exact amount, and any miss stops with a person.
Digest [S16] says fingerprint clocking was fined. This design does not use biometrics.
Digest [S17] says worker monitoring and creditworthiness of natural persons are high-risk. This design does not score a customer.

assumptions: Account identifier, written amount, numerical amount, and stored funds are stored on the account record. The account record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not paid. Stored funds are not a credit score.
Native configuration of the account record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
The release is the signed payout and no other amount.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining check is still the teller verifying signatures.

incremental.description: Refresh account identifier, written amount, and stored funds when the payment layout changes, and drop a payout the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many signatures are blank. The high end assumes account identifier and stored funds are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teller spends the week at the window, on the cash, and on the signed amount. A stored total, a fee from a stored rule, and filing that signature can move. The teller still counts the cash, checks the signature, and releases the payment.
reach: A customer receives only the amount the teller signed.
A colleague posts only the deposit the teller signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout that the teller has not signed.
Reject a fee that does not match the stored rule.
Reject a balance that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed payout or statement can go out the same day, and the teller still owns the cash.
